newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: StanChart leads 250 mln rgt fund raising for state.
newsitem.headline: StanChart leads 250 mln rgt fund raising for state.

text.p: Standard Chartered Malaysia is leading a consortium of nine banks to provide a 250 million ringgit loan for the development of the Malaysian state of Pahang, the official Bernama news agency reported on Tuesday.

Most of the syndicated revolving loan extended to the Pahang State Development Corp (PASDEC) will be used to build industries in the state, Bernama said after the signing ceremony for the loan in east-coast Pahang's capital, Kuantan.
The balance will be used for the revolving capital of the industries, it added.

Apart from Standard Chartered, the banks involved are Bank Simpanan Nasional, The Bank of Nova Scotia Bhd, EON Bank Bhd, Southern Bank Bhd, Allied Bank (Malaysia) Bhd, BSN Merchant Bank Bhd and DCB Bank dan Amanah Merchant Bank Bhd.
Bernama did not give a breakdown on how the loan would be disbursed.
Standard Chartered Malaysia is a unit of Standard Chartered Plc.
Pahang Chief Minister Khalil Yaakob said PASDEC has forecast a profit of 162.5 million ringgit for calendar 1997 compared the to 145.4 million ringgit achieved in 1996.

He said PASDEC would attempt to consolidate its existing activities in the commercial, real estate, manufacturing, hotel and plantation, industrial park development sectors and venture into information technology and health services.
